tiles.title: Layer 0 ratified
tiles.body: Purpose Charter, Scope Declaration, Invariants Register and Identity Constraints Register adopted by Constitutional vote, effective 2026-07-03.

tiles.title: ecohubsOS voting live
tiles.body: Governance now runs on the internal ecohubsOS voting app; the in-app proposal page is the decision record for every vote.

tiles.title: Meeting templates complete
tiles.body: All five meeting templates drafted and in review: governance, coordination, operations, conflict, reflection.

tiles.title: Change protocol added
tiles.body: Layer 6 now specifies how RCOS artifacts themselves can be amended.
